authorization: User requested tiered comparison, 10000 fixed-seed scenario draws, proxy sensitivity and limited-scope readiness
conditional_policy: No pooled or cross-baseline score ranking. Evaluate prerequisite closure and additional catchment coverage for each extension.
weight_rationale: Declared illustrative stress profiles, not elicited stakeholder weights. Ridership profile allocates 70% across projected load/current maximum load/current ridership; equity profile assigns 50% to equity. Correlated demand measures may double count demand.
draw_distribution: City method and weight profile independently uniform; six distinct combinations. Repeat frequency measures this declared discrete scenario distribution, not population confidence.
equity_normalization: Population-SD z-score fitted on the 16 main-tier corridor equity fractions; frozen across City/weight scenarios and endpoint/suppression stress comparisons
city_normalization: Retain published City z scores and their declared substitutions; do not restandardize imputed columns
tie_rule: Competition rank intervals with tolerance 1e-12; stable top-k requires worst tied rank <= k
high_confidence_rule: Strictly above 0.90 simulated top5 frequency AND exact six-combination frequency above 0.90; descriptive scenario stability only
shortlist_rule: Choose three main-tier corridors by descending exact six-scenario top5 frequency, descending exact top3 frequency, ascending exact mean midpoint rank, ascending worst rank, ascending corridor ID; MC frequencies are reported but do not break exact scenario ties
geometry_policy: Declared 500m current-road proxies; no claim of approved transit alignment or station catchment
woodbine_sensitivity: Shared Woodbine anchor for corridors 5 and 6; nominal plus 8 bearings at 250m; rebuild RNF shortest paths, buffers and CT shares
readiness_scope: Executable tiered proxy-scenario model; not verified transit geography, harmonized forecasts, construction feasibility or final submission clearance
limitations: Six discrete scenario combinations do not exhaust weight or missing-data uncertainty
Weights are declared analytical choices and correlated demand criteria may double count
CITY_BASE_0 means the City's funded/under-construction base network, not absence of existing infrastructure
Tiering excludes conditional corridors from the absolute main ranking; it does not reconstruct their independent benefits
Road proxy and endpoint choices, mixed road vintages/methods and uniform CT density remain assumptions
2020 income/2021 population and City observed/forecast vintages differ
Observed-minimum substitution is not a theoretical worst-case bound
Woodbine is a sourced approximate secondary coordinate; sensitivity does not verify its official site
Jane subsection City construction lengths disagree with measured road proxy lengths; current ridership is length-scaled, so corridor 12 source-score interpretation remains a material review issue
